d.title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken: Clayman Revenge
d.en: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Clayman's Revenge
d.jp: 転生したらスライムだった件 クレイマンREVENGE
d.synopsis: After that final scream rang out during the Walpurgis Festival, the dreams of the Marionette Master were thought to be done for good. But either through the vagaries of fate or the decision of the world at large, Clayman's theater has opened up for one more act.

rel.name: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 2nd Season Part 2
